name: embedded-prototype-layout
description: Resolves prototype layout pressure at the actual parent and iframe boundary. Applies when a self-contained instrument works standalone but its embedded controls, tables, focus, shadows or onward route become difficult to use.

contract.what: A measured parent/child layout contract that keeps a compact preview useful for deciding whether to continue in a full view, while preserving the instrument's meaningful interactions and comparisons.
when: An iframe behaves differently from its standalone child document, or parent composition changes the space available to that embedded document.
boundaries: The parent owns placement, reserved dimensions, title, embedding policy and full-view route. The child owns its internal document and controls. Packaging owns declared projection changes. Local canonical-child evidence, live hosted delivery, accessibility conformance and permission changes retain separate observations and authority.
contract.result: One source-owned repair or decision-ready disposition naming the parent viewport, content box, frame/client width, child viewport, affected behavior, smallest fitting layout change and evidence boundary. Each dimension is measured or explicitly unobserved with a request to its measurement owner.

receivingUse.job: An iframe behaves differently from its standalone child document, or parent composition changes the space available to that embedded document.
receivingUse.materialResult: One source-owned repair or decision-ready disposition naming the parent viewport, content box, frame/client width, child viewport, affected behavior, smallest fitting layout change and evidence boundary. Each dimension is measured or explicitly unobserved with a request to its measurement owner.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
